summary: brrClean native GTCRN voice rebuild and QuickType availability improvements after signed v1.0.206. Requires exact-SHA debug/full Android CI and original-signed Obtainium verification before release.

changes.title: First-keystroke QuickType availability and stable word animation
changes.detail: Prepare next-word predictions when eligible text fields open; show an immediate, non-inserting literal-prefix fallback after the first key; deliver completed decoder results asynchronously only to the matching editor, request, text and cursor; refresh after dictionary loading; and reuse fixed three-slot suggestion views during ordinary updates. Keep all first-frame text fully opaque with native text-shaping fallbacks. Autocorrection at Space/Return retains a bounded freshness guard. No prediction ranking, BR Brain, voice, package, model, permissions, learning or signing change. Oppo hardware behavior remains to be confirmed by its owner.

changes.title: brrClean native noise reduction and verified microphone routing
changes.detail: Replace the failing active ONNX denoiser with pinned MIT native C++ GTCRN, bundled weights and a separate short-lived crash-contained process; retain offline Parakeet 110M and exact raw-audio fallback. Add true OFF/Android/brrClean selection (OFF also disables enhancement in the lab), actual native success/fallback/latency in BR Brain, same-take original/processed lab listening, and Android 12+ Bluetooth communication-device activation with confirmed-route/silence rejection. Guard ARM64-only NEON instructions so the engine also compiles for ARM32. Add source-hash, C++ model smoke and APK native/library/license gates. No speech or audio logs, runtime network, bigger ASR model or background denoising while typing. Bluetooth on Oppo/Nirvana Ion still requires owner hardware acceptance.
